observations: Opened assets/panels/01-1.png: a wide morning shot of a whitewashed clinic with a blue corrugated awning, a hibiscus and a second potted plant at left, palm trees and a street beyond. This matches the source's 'Morning at a friendly neighbourhood Tamil Nadu clinic'.

Dr. Ananya stands in the doorway left of centre, facing the viewer and smiling with her mouth open. Compared with main-cast.png she matches: low bun with loose strands, gold stud, almond eyes, white coat open over a teal kurta, stethoscope around her neck, dark leggings, flat sandals.

Hands checked against the record. Her extended open palm is on the image-right side of her body, which is her left hand, gesturing inward. Her right hand hangs empty at her side. Both match production.hands.ananya.

An elderly woman in a lilac saree with a grey bun and a shoulder bag is seen from behind, stepping toward the door. Two waiting patients, a man and a woman with a jasmine braid, sit at right on perforated grey metal chairs, seen from behind. This matches the scene text.
Inside, the reception desk has stacked registers, a beige corded phone and binders. No spine or label text is readable. props [] is acceptable because these are background items.

The top-left of the raw art has a hard-edged plain white block where the sky band should be. In page-01.png the caption box 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' covers almost all of it, and the strip that remains reads as panel margin or white wall.
The caption sits top-left in the reading entry and does not overlap Ananya's face. The exit to the lower row works.
